Experienced Java Developer with 6 years of expertise in backend development, microservices, and cloud-based
applications. Procient in Spring Boot, AWS (EC2, RDS, S3), Kafka, and CI/CD pipelines. Skilled in designing
scalable, high-performance RESTful APIs. Adept at leading Agile teams and delivering solutions that improve
system performance by up to 20%. Seeking a Java/Microservices Developer role in Germany to contribute to
innovative software projects and collaborate in an international environment.

experience.company: ployed services on AWS (EC2, RDS, S3), Enhanced Kafka-based event-driven ar-
